placement.section_heading: How AI Citation Trackers Actually Work

h2: How to Check AI Citations Manually Before Using a Tracker
html:
How to Check AI Citations Manually Before Using a Tracker

You can start checking AI citations without specialized software. Choose five to ten search queries that your customers would realistically ask, then test those queries in AI search platforms such as ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews where available.

For each query, record:

  • The search query and date of the check.
  • The AI platform used.
  • Whether your brand or website is mentioned.
  • Which exact URLs appear as cited sources.
  • Which competing websites are cited instead.

Save the results in a spreadsheet and repeat the same checks periodically. Use consistent queries so you can compare what was observed across different dates.

Manual checks provide useful examples, but they do not establish your overall citation frequency or guarantee reproducible results. AI answers may change between sessions, users, locations, and platforms.

An AI citation tracker can help organize citation observations and reduce repeated manual work. The features available depend on the tool you use.
